prompt: For each country_code, how much net revenue came from web lines and how much from store lines, side by side? Use the sales table, where channel is 'web' or 'store'. Return country_code, web_revenue_eur and store_revenue_eur, one row per country. Any row order is fine. Which query returns it?

options.text:
SELECT country_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS web_revenue_eur,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS store_revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code

SELECT country_code, channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code, channel

SELECT country_code,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS web_revenue_eur,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS store_revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code

SELECT country_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS web_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS store_revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code
